app_user_name_check.name: app_user_name_check
app_user_name_check.value: ("app_user"."first_name" is null or char_length("app_user"."first_name") between 1 and 60) and ("app_user"."last_name" is null or char_length("app_user"."last_name") between 1 and 60)

app_user_default_boat_check.name: app_user_default_boat_check
app_user_default_boat_check.value: default_boat_type is null or default_boat_type in ('C1x', 'C2x', 'C2x+', 'C4x+', 'C4+', '1x', '2x', '2-', '2+', '4x', '4-', '4+', '4x+', '8+')

rower_read.name: rower_read
rower_read.using: rowlens_roster_manager() or "rower"."user_id" = rowlens_user_id() or "rower"."id" in (select rowlens_training_rower_ids())

rowing_session_role_read.name: rowing_session_role_read
rowing_session_role_read.using: rowlens_can_read_trainings() and (current_setting('app.training_permissions', true) = 'owner-or-staff' or rowlens_sees_all() or "rowing_session"."created_by_user_id" = rowlens_user_id() or rowlens_session_reachable("rowing_session"."id"))

user_settings_audit_add.name: user_settings_audit_add
user_settings_audit_add.withCheck: rowlens_has_role('admin') and "user_settings_audit"."actor_user_id" = rowlens_user_id() and exists (select 1 from membership m where m.club_id = "user_settings_audit"."club_id" and m.user_id = "user_settings_audit"."subject_user_id")
